title: Lapland: what EUR 1,000,000 a year should buy first in lung cancer care
markdown:
# Lapland: what EUR 1,000,000 a year should buy first in lung cancer care

## The gap in one sentence
Lapland had 227.0 lung cancer deaths per 100,000 residents aged 65+ in 2021–2025, against 178.6 nationally, the highest of 23 counties [^statfin_13u5]. Only 18.5% of its lung cancer patients got curative-intent treatment in 2019–2023, against 27.0% nationally, the lowest of 22 counties [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. The gap to the top-quartile county rate is about 16.8 patients a year, arithmetic on registry shares rather than a causal estimate [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. The model estimates 155 days (142–168) from first symptom to treatment start [^model].

## Where the days are lost
The step furthest above the national value is first symptom to first primary care contact, estimated at 63 days (53–74) against 56 nationally [^model]. Two of the model's drivers are higher smoking (11.4% daily smokers vs 9.1% nationally) [^sotkanet_4404] and a much larger sparsely populated rural share (28.6% vs 4.4%) [^statfin_11ra]. The only measured step is diagnosis to treatment start [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28]. It is 29.6 days, measured for the Northern Finland (OYS) collaborative area and weighted by Lapland's treatment mix, against 36.9 nationally [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
1. **What:** A symptom awareness campaign telling people with a cough lasting over three weeks to see a doctor. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society nationally, with county communications and primary care delivering locally. **Cost:** EUR 13,931 a year, scaled from the roadmap budget, with yearly repetition assumed [^model][^roadmap_1.3.2]. **Expected effect:** No days saved, and an estimated 0.58 deaths avoided a year (0.25–0.88) [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1][^ev_symptom_campaign_2][^ev_symptom_campaign_3] **Roadmap:** 1.3.2, a national communication plan on cancer symptoms [^roadmap_1.3.2].
2. **What:** Low-dose CT screening, with smoking cessation support, for long-term heavy smokers aged 50–74. **Owner:** The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko decide, the Finnish Cancer Registry steers and the county delivers. **Cost:** EUR 548,645 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** No days saved, and an estimated 4.38 deaths avoided a year (3.21–5.56), with benefits arriving only after years [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_ldct_screening_1][^ev_ldct_screening_2][^ev_ldct_screening_3][^ev_ldct_screening_4] **Roadmap:** 2.3.4, new national screening programmes [^roadmap_2.3.4].
3. **What:** Cessation medication and counselling for every current smoker at the first specialist visit. **Owner:** The chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology. **Cost:** EUR 57,800 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** No days saved, and an estimated 0.45 deaths avoided a year (0.31–0.58) [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1][^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_2] **Roadmap:** 3.1.2, cancer-specific care pathway descriptions [^roadmap_3.1.2].

## What to measure from Monday
- Record the date of the first symptom and of the first primary care contact for each lung cancer patient [^model].
- Record the days from referral to the first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer [^model].
- Record the days from the first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and from diagnosis to treatment start for the county itself [^model].
- Record stage at diagnosis for every lung cancer [^model].

## Limits of this analysis
The first four step days are county-level estimates built from assumed priors, not measurements of individual pathways [^model]. As a check, not a validation, none of three measured outcomes correlated with the estimated clock beyond chance [^model]. The closest was the curative-intent share (rho −0.30, permutation p 0.17) [^model]. The national 155-day total was reported by Yle in 2026 from an unpublished four-city Finnish study, and two of the five step figures are residuals rather than measurements [^model].
